---
title: "Session 4: International Welfare State Models and Social Protection"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
### Guiding question
How do different welfare state models promote or restrict social inclusion?
:::

This session compares welfare state models and asks how political and institutional frameworks shape access to social rights, resources and participation.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .session-box}
#### Topics

- Development and functions of the welfare state
- International welfare state models
- Social protection and poverty reduction
- Universalism and selectivism
- Social rights and access to benefits
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .session-box}
#### Key theories and concepts

- Welfare Regime Theory (Gøsta Esping-Andersen)
- Social Protection
- Universalism versus Selectivism
:::
